notes.title: Thank You for Your Feedback!
notes.content:
THANK YOU!


Thank you to every who played our Steam Next Fest Demo and an even bigger thank you to everyone who submitted feedback! We enjoyed the festival and are eager to show what we have changed thanks to your feedback!



The 3 most common pieces of feedback we received were the following:

Enemies were too small

The Tower Shop was a little tedious

Fast forward or time scale controls were needed

We are happy to announce that we have changed/implemented all of the above! 

The enemies are now much bigger so that destroying them is more satisfying! 

The tower shop no longer has a scroll bar and instead all the towers are always visible!

3 time scale buttons have been implemented allowing you to choose from 1x, 2x, and 3x speed!



Again we want to thank everyone who participated and gave feedback! You have all helped us make a better version of our game and we cannot wait to share the full game with you all very soon!



Thank you for reading



~ Monkey Tale Games

notes.title: SCRAP WARS: TD DEMO LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
Scrap Wars: TD now has a Limited Demo available for free to anyone who wishes to try it! In the Demo, you can access 1 scenario, The Red Ruins! Along with all the towers and enemies the game has to offer! Earn badges for your victories and try to get the Mastery Badge!

In the full game, an additional 2 maps will be available, each with varying difficulty and matching endless modes!

Players can give feedback through a Google form with a link provided in the Demo! Any and all feedback is greatly appreciated!

Thank you for reading and we hope you enjoy the Demo!

- Monkey Tale Games
